definitions.anytime: anytime-valid statements as reported: L* = running max over report epochs (every 30 epochs + the last) of the K = 16 mixture LCB, L+ = max(L*, S); U = the UCS mixture at the final epoch, U+ = min(U, Dcap); miss = wrong at SOME epoch (flags lcs_tu / ucs_tu)
definitions.ft1: fixed-time single-eta Chernoff LCB L = Qhat - l/eta - eta V/2 with eta = eta*(V_ref) = sqrt(2 l/V_ref) (the LCS grid centre) and Fan UCB U = Qhat + (l + W(eta_U))/eta_U with eta_U = min(0.999/cbar, eta*); l = log(1/alpha_side)
definitions.ftb: fixed-time Bernstein with the floor-based design-variance bound kappa Q, kappa = bbar (1-phi)/phi: L_B = (sqrt(kappa l/2 + Qhat - kappa l/3) - sqrt(kappa l/2))^2 (0 if Qhat <= kappa l/3), U_B = (sqrt(kappa l/2) + sqrt(kappa l/2 + Qhat + bbar l/3))^2; populations fixed in advance (not part reactor)
definitions.fth: as ft1 with the centre tuned to the evaluation horizon: V_ref_ft = V_ref x (window epochs)/2880 for training-sourced V_ref (fallback bbar^2/phi0 unchanged)
definitions.ftx: exact worst-case Poisson-binomial bounds of the retained-hit count K = S under the least favourable placement of the hits among the eligible units (static designs only, indicator estimands with <= 1000 hits)
definitions.lower_radius_ratio: (Qhat - L)/(Qhat - L_E) per rep, L_E = the anytime K = 16 mixture at the final epoch with the same V_E: the width price of the K-point mixture vs ONE pre-registered eta (Chernoff-type bounds only); 'runmax' = (Qhat - L*)/(Qhat - L_E) <= 1, the gain of the running max (only where L_E < 0)
definitions.lower_radius_vs_wald: (Qhat - L)/(z_{1-alpha/2} sqrt(Vhat)) per rep with Vhat > 0
definitions.miss: lower = L > Q at the final epoch (anytime: L_e > Q_e at some epoch); upper = U < Q (indicator pairs, statement issued); two_sided = either; pooled over pairs and rho in {1, 2, 5}%; nominal 0.025 per side; Wilson 95% intervals; n_pairs_signif_above_nominal = pairs whose Wilson lower bound exceeds the nominal
definitions.mixE: the same K = 16 / UCS mixtures evaluated ONCE at the final epoch (L_E without running max): their fixed-time use (Markov and Ville share the threshold 1/alpha_side); miss flags lcs_ft / ucs_ft
definitions.pair: (stream, estimand, rho), honest variant, part main unless stated
definitions.rel_gap: (Q - max(L, S))/Q at the final epoch = the reported lower statement; per pair the median over the first 200 reps, then median [IQR] over pairs (Q > 0); 'anytime_same_pairs' = the anytime value on the same pairs when a comparator exists only for a subset (ftx; ftb in part reactor)
definitions.rel_gap_raw: (Q - L)/Q clipped at 1 (the bound alone, without S)
definitions.share_L_gt_S: L > S (the bound says more than the count of retained hits): per_rep pooled over (pair, width rep); pairs_ge_half = share of pairs with L > S in >= 50% of their width reps (rev0 rule of share_Lstar_gt_S_*); pairs_any = in at least one rep
definitions.share_U_lt_Dcap: U < Dcap (the upper statement beats the sure cap): per_rep = mean over indicator pairs of the per-pair share of issued reps; pairs_ge_half as above
definitions.strata: by the stream total Q: Q1-5, Q6-20, Q1-20, Q>20, Q>0 (pooled), Q=0 (upper side and shares only)
definitions.two_sided_capped_ratio: (min(U, Dcap) - max(L, S))/(U+ - L+) with the reported anytime U+ = min(U_UCS, Dcap), L+ = max(L*, S); indicator pairs, reps with U+ > L+
definitions.two_sided_ratio: (U - L)/(U_UCS - L_E), raw bounds of the Chernoff/Fan type, indicator pairs
definitions.upper_radius_ratio: (U - Qhat)/(U_UCS - Qhat) per issued rep, indicator pairs (U_UCS = anytime UCS at the final epoch)
definitions.upper_radius_vs_wald: (U - Qhat)/(z sqrt(Vhat)) per issued rep with Vhat > 0, indicator pairs
definitions.v_over_vref: median [IQR] over pairs of the per-pair median V_E/V_ref (centring of eta*; ft1/mixture radius ratio is a function of it, see theory)
definitions.validity: ft1/fth: Prop. 1(b)/(c) supermartingale with ONE eta + Markov at the fixed final epoch (Prop. 2(a) domination under X := 0); ftb: sub-gamma (Bennett) bound with Var <= kappa Q for any predictable design with pi >= phi; ftx: super-uniform worst-case p-values (static designs); no tuning on test streams (V_ref from training folds, phi0 and cbar committed, window length = metadata)
definitions.wald: Wald Qhat -+ z_{1-alpha/2} sqrt(Vhat) at the final epoch (not valid; Vhat = 0 without a retained hit)
definitions.widths_in_json: width_rho0.05 only; every rho (and the same blocks) in results/summary/E2_fixedtime_rev1.parquet
